description:
Research spill neutralization agents for hazardous materials. 

Your goal is to look up the 'Non-Fire Response' recommendations for five specific chemicals on the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) and identify the specific neutralizing agents recommended (e.g., lime, soda ash, vinegar, etc.).

Chemicals to research:
1. Nitric Acid, Red Fuming (CAS 7697-37-2)
2. Sodium Hydroxide, Solution (CAS 1310-73-2)
3. Hydrofluoric Acid (CAS 7664-39-3)
4. Hydrazine, Anhydrous (CAS 302-01-2)
5. Toluene (CAS 108-88-3)

Create a CSV file at '~/Documents/neutralizer_inventory.csv' with the header 'Chemical,Recommended_Neutralizers'. For each chemical, list the neutralizing agents found in the 'Non-Fire Response' section. If the datasheet does NOT recommend a neutralizing agent (e.g., it only says to absorb/dike), write 'None'.

Example row:
Nitric Acid Red Fuming,Agricultural lime; Crushed limestone; Sodium bicarbonate
